name: Start-Up Visa Program (SUV)

application_window.note: IRCC stopped accepting new SUV applications after 11:59 p.m. Dec 31, 2025. Only applicants with a valid 2025 commitment certificate may still file for PR, until 30 June 2026.

requirements.blocker_text: This historically required a commitment from a designated organization: a venture-capital fund (≥$200,000 investment), a business-angel group (≥$75,000), or acceptance by a business incubator — but IRCC is not accepting new applications as of this verification.

sources.title: Start-up Visa Program - IRCC (application pause notice)

notes: GENUINE 'PAUSED, NOT CLOSED FOREVER' CASE — marked 'draft' as the closest schema fit, same convention used for us_diversity_visa. IRCC stopped accepting new SUV applications after 11:59 p.m. 31 December 2025; only applicants holding a VALID 2025 commitment certificate may still file for permanent residence, with a hard deadline of 30 June 2026 — meaning as of this verification, even that transitional window has closed. Optional SUV open-work-permit intake ended 19 December 2025. Backlog was reportedly ~42,000+ applications (including dependants) at the time of the pause. Federal Business category (shared with ca_self_employed) is capped at 500 PR admissions/year regardless. IRCC has signalled a new targeted entrepreneur pilot may launch in 2026, not yet confirmed as operational.
